verses.text_urhobo: Nẹ otọ rhe Ọghẹnẹ vwọ ma odjuvwu vẹ akpọ.
verses.text_romanized: ne oto rhe oghene vwo ma odjuvwu ve akpo

verses.text_urhobo: Akpọ na da de dia reghe reghe diodi, ebrin da enu rẹ akpọ na duvwu; Erhi rẹ Ọghẹnẹ kọye re yan vwẹ enu rẹ ame na.
verses.text_romanized: akpo na da de dia reghe reghe diodi ebrin da enu re akpo na duvwu erhi re oghene koye re yan vwe enu re ame na

verses.text_urhobo: Etiyin Ọghẹnẹ da ta, E gbe jẹn orẹmrẹ dia, orẹmrẹ da ghene dia.
verses.text_romanized: etiyin oghene da ta e gbe jen oremre dia oremre da ghene dia

verses.text_urhobo: Ọghẹnẹ da mrẹ nẹ orẹmrẹ na yoma; Ọghẹnẹ da hẹriẹ orẹmrẹ na nẹ ebrin na.
verses.text_romanized: oghene da mre ne oremre na yoma oghene da herie oremre na ne ebrin na

verses.text_urhobo: Ọghẹnẹ de se orẹmrẹ na Uvo, o de rhe se ebrin na Ason. Te ovwọnvwọn te irhiọke da dia ẹdẹ rẹsosuọ.
verses.text_romanized: oghene de se oremre na uvo o de rhe se ebrin na ason te ovwonvwon te irhioke da dia ede resosuo

verses.text_urhobo: Ọghẹnẹ da tanẹ, Gbe jẹn irharheghe dia uherevie rẹ ame na, rere ọ hẹriẹ ame na vwo nẹ ame na.
verses.text_romanized: oghene da tane gbe jen irharheghe dia uherevie re ame na rere o herie ame na vwo ne ame na

verses.text_urhobo: Ọghẹnẹ da ma irharheghe na o da hẹriẹ ame rọ obotọ rẹ irharheghe na vwo nẹ ame rọ obenu rẹ irharheghe na. O da ghene dia ọtiọye.
verses.text_romanized: oghene da ma irharheghe na o da herie ame ro oboto re irharheghe na vwo ne ame ro obenu re irharheghe na o da ghene dia otioye

verses.text_urhobo: Ọghẹnẹ de se irharheghe na Odjuvwu. Te ovwọnvwọn te irhiọke da dia ẹdẹ rivẹ.
verses.text_romanized: oghene de se irharheghe na odjuvwu te ovwonvwon te irhioke da dia ede rive

verses.text_urhobo: Ọghẹnẹ da ta, Gbe jẹn ame rẹ otọ rẹ odjuvwu na rhi koko oma vwẹ asan ọvo, rere e ji otọ ọyaya vwẹ oma phia. Ọ da ghene dia ọtiọye.
verses.text_romanized: oghene da ta gbe jen ame re oto re odjuvwu na rhi koko oma vwe asan ovo rere e ji oto oyaya vwe oma phia o da ghene dia otioye

verses.text_urhobo: Ọghẹnẹ se otọ ọyaya na Otọ, ame rọ rha ghwe koko asan ọvo na o de rhe se Urhie, Ọghẹnẹ da mrẹ ne oyoma.
verses.text_romanized: oghene se oto oyaya na oto ame ro rha ghwe koko asan ovo na o de rhe se urhie oghene da mre ne oyoma

verses.text_urhobo: Ọghẹnẹ da ta, Gbe jẹn otọ na di ẹbe, irhe re mọn kugbe irhe re emamọ rẹ ibi dia evun rayen, durhe doghere rọye vwe evun rẹ otọ na. O da ghene dia ọtiọye.
verses.text_romanized: oghene da ta gbe jen oto na di ebe irhe re mon kugbe irhe re emamo re ibi dia evun rayen durhe doghere roye vwe evun re oto na o da ghene dia otioye

verses.text_urhobo: Otọ na de ghine di ẹbe, irhe re mọn emamọ durhe doghere rọye kugbe irhe re mọn emamọ rẹ ibi dia evun rayen, durhe doghẹre rọye Ọghẹnẹ da mrẹ nẹ oyoma.
verses.text_romanized: oto na de ghine di ebe irhe re mon emamo durhe doghere roye kugbe irhe re mon emamo re ibi dia evun rayen durhe doghere roye oghene da mre ne oyoma

verses.text_urhobo: Te ovwọnvwọn te irhiọke da dia ẹdẹ rerha.
verses.text_romanized: te ovwonvwon te irhioke da dia ede rerha

verses.text_urhobo: Ọghẹnẹ da ta, Gbe jẹn orẹmrẹ phia vwẹ evun rẹ irharheghe rẹ odjuvwu na rọ hẹriẹ uvo nẹ ason, re ayen dia kẹ oka kugbe ọke vẹ ẹdẹ te ukpe,
verses.text_romanized: oghene da ta gbe jen oremre phia vwe evun re irharheghe re odjuvwu na ro herie uvo ne ason re ayen dia ke oka kugbe oke ve ede te ukpe

verses.text_urhobo: gbe jẹn ayen dia orẹmrẹ vwẹ evun rẹ irharheghe rẹ odjuvwu na rọ vwẹ orẹmrẹ kẹ akpọ na. O da ghene dia ọtiọye.
verses.text_romanized: gbe jen ayen dia oremre vwe evun re irharheghe re odjuvwu na ro vwe oremre ke akpo na o da ghene dia otioye

verses.text_urhobo: Ọghẹnẹ da ma irhukpẹ ride ive, urhukpẹ rode na kọye ri sun uvo, urhukpẹ re otete na kọye ri sun ason, ọ ke je ma isio rhe.
verses.text_romanized: oghene da ma irhukpe ride ive urhukpe rode na koye ri sun uvo urhukpe re otete na koye ri sun ason o ke je ma isio rhe

verses.text_urhobo: Ọghẹnẹ de phi ayen phihọ irharheghe rẹ odjuvwu na re ọ vwẹ orẹmrẹ kẹ akpọ na,
verses.text_romanized: oghene de phi ayen phiho irharheghe re odjuvwu na re o vwe oremre ke akpo na

verses.text_urhobo: ri sun vwẹ enu rẹ uvo vẹ ason na, kugbe rere e rha hẹriẹ ebrin vwo nẹ orẹmrẹ. Ọghẹnẹ da mrẹ nẹ oyoma.
verses.text_romanized: ri sun vwe enu re uvo ve ason na kugbe rere e rha herie ebrin vwo ne oremre oghene da mre ne oyoma

verses.text_urhobo: Te ovwọnvwọn te irhiọke da dia ẹdẹ rẹne.
verses.text_romanized: te ovwonvwon te irhioke da dia ede rene

verses.text_urhobo: Ọghẹnẹ da ta, Gbe jẹn obo ri vwo arhọ ejobi vọn evun rẹ ame na, rere ephran rhan vwẹ enu rẹ akpọ na vwẹ irharheghe rẹ odjuvwu.
verses.text_romanized: oghene da ta gbe jen obo ri vwo arho ejobi von evun re ame na rere ephran rhan vwe enu re akpo na vwe irharheghe re odjuvwu

verses.text_urhobo: Etiyin Ọghẹnẹ da ma eranvwe ride na, kugbe eranvwe keranvwe ekpokpọ re yan re rhẹrhẹ, re vọn evun rẹ ame na, dohwo doka rọye, kugbe ọphran kọphran ro vwo ibekpe dọphran doghere rọye. Ọghẹnẹ da mrẹ nẹ oyoma.
verses.text_romanized: etiyin oghene da ma eranvwe ride na kugbe eranvwe keranvwe ekpokpo re yan re rherhe re von evun re ame na dohwo doka roye kugbe ophran kophran ro vwo ibekpe dophran doghere roye oghene da mre ne oyoma

verses.text_urhobo: Ọghẹnẹ da nẹ ẹrhovwo kẹ ayen tanẹ, We vwiẹ ri we bun phihọ re wa vọn ame rẹ urhie na, rere ephran rhe bun phihọ vwẹ enu rẹ akpọ na.
verses.text_romanized: oghene da ne erhovwo ke ayen tane we vwie ri we bun phiho re wa von ame re urhie na rere ephran rhe bun phiho vwe enu re akpo na

verses.text_urhobo: Te ovwọnvwọn te irhiọke da dia ẹdẹ riyori.
verses.text_romanized: te ovwonvwon te irhioke da dia ede riyori

verses.text_urhobo: Ọghẹnẹ da ta, Gbe jẹn akpọ na vwẹ eranvwe ekpokpọ vwọ phia, kueranvwe kuoka, uchuru kugbe obo ri kpono kugbe eranvwe re djoma; deranvwe doka rayen. Ọ da ghene dia ọtiọye.
verses.text_romanized: oghene da ta gbe jen akpo na vwe eranvwe ekpokpo vwo phia kueranvwe kuoka uchuru kugbe obo ri kpono kugbe eranvwe re djoma deranvwe doka rayen o da ghene dia otioye

verses.text_urhobo: Ọghẹnẹ da ma eranvwe rẹ akpọ na, deranvwe doka rayen kugbe uchuru okoka rọye, kugbe emu kemu ri kpono vwẹ otọ na okoka rọye. Ọghẹnẹ da mrẹ nẹ oyoma.
verses.text_romanized: oghene da ma eranvwe re akpo na deranvwe doka rayen kugbe uchuru okoka roye kugbe emu kemu ri kpono vwe oto na okoka roye oghene da mre ne oyoma

verses.text_urhobo: Etiyin Ọghẹnẹ da ta, Gbe jẹn avwanre ma ohwo vwẹ oma rẹ avwanre, rọ họhọ avwanre, re ayen vwo ogangan vwẹ enu rẹ erin rẹ urhie, vwẹ enu rẹ ephran ri obenu, vwẹ enu rẹ uchuru, kugbe vwẹ enu rẹ akpọ na vẹ obo ri kpono vwẹ enu rẹ otọ na.
verses.text_romanized: etiyin oghene da ta gbe jen avwanre ma ohwo vwe oma re avwanre ro hoho avwanre re ayen vwo ogangan vwe enu re erin re urhie vwe enu re ephran ri obenu vwe enu re uchuru kugbe vwe enu re akpo na ve obo ri kpono vwe enu re oto na

verses.text_urhobo: Kọye Ọghẹnẹ da ma ohwo vwẹ oma rọye, oma rẹ Ọghẹnẹ ọye ọ vwọ ma ayen, ọshare vẹ aye ọ ma ayen.
verses.text_romanized: koye oghene da ma ohwo vwe oma roye oma re oghene oye o vwo ma ayen oshare ve aye o ma ayen

verses.text_urhobo: Etiyin Ọghẹnẹ da ta kẹ ayen, We vwiẹ ri we bun phihọ, re wa vọn akpọ na, ru we phio kparobọ, kugbe re we vwo ogangan vwẹ enu rẹ erin rẹ urhie, ephran ri obenu kugbe enu ri kemu kemu rọ yan vwe otọ na ejobi.
verses.text_romanized: etiyin oghene da ta ke ayen we vwie ri we bun phiho re wa von akpo na ru we phio kparobo kugbe re we vwo ogangan vwe enu re erin re urhie ephran ri obenu kugbe enu ri kemu kemu ro yan vwe oto na ejobi

verses.text_urhobo: Ọghẹnẹ da ta, Nighe, Me reyọ urhe kurhe rọ mọn ubi ejobi rọ enu rẹ otọ na vwọ kẹ wẹ, kugbe urhe kurhe rọ mọn emamọ kọ dia emuọre kẹ ovwan.
verses.text_romanized: oghene da ta nighe me reyo urhe kurhe ro mon ubi ejobi ro enu re oto na vwo ke we kugbe urhe kurhe ro mon emamo ko dia emuore ke ovwan

verses.text_urhobo: Eranvwe keranvwe rọ otọ na, ọphran kọphran rọ obenu, emu kemu ri kpono vwẹ enu rẹ otọ na, emu kemu ro vwo ẹnwẹn vwẹ otọ na, Me vwẹ ẹbe ọkpokpọ na re dia emuọre ke ayen. Ọ da ghene dia ọtiọye.
verses.text_romanized: eranvwe keranvwe ro oto na ophran kophran ro obenu emu kemu ri kpono vwe enu re oto na emu kemu ro vwo enwen vwe oto na me vwe ebe okpokpo na re dia emuore ke ayen o da ghene dia otioye

verses.text_urhobo: Ọghẹnẹ da mrẹ emu kemu rọ mare na, nighe, oyovwiri gangan Te ovwọnvwọn te irhiọke da dia ẹdẹ resan.
verses.text_romanized: oghene da mre emu kemu ro mare na nighe oyovwiri gangan te ovwonvwon te irhioke da dia ede resan
